anchors.name: Build events StartBuild
anchors.reason: Accepted production start: charges team resources and writes buildClass +0x300/build time +0x304. Released callers include Armory launch 0x473210 and BuildGoto constructor 0x49dfa0.

anchors.name: Build events CancelBuild
anchors.reason: Refunds the active build and clears buildClass; returns false when no build. Called by Producer simulation and removal. Completion uses separate virtual FinishBuild, avoiding destructor-based false cancellation.

anchors.name: Build events FinishBuild
anchors.reason: Shared Producer completion slot +0xa8 in Recycler/Factory/ConstructionRig secondary vtables; creates object, makes it local, dispatches AddObject and clears active class. Final eax loads the created object local.

anchors.name: Build events ArmoryFinishBuild
anchors.reason: Armory override at vtable 0x875cb0+0xa8. Calls ObjectLobber to launch selected class and clears buildClass, returning null by design.

anchors.name: Player identity NetPlayerCreate
anchors.reason: Released NetPlayer constructor copies all four UserId words into +0x30..0x3c; stores 16-bit network id at +0x28. FindNetPlayer(id) supplies live registry identity.

anchors.name: Player identity UserIdFromSteam
anchors.reason: UserId Steam constructor writes discriminator 1 at +0 and Steam uint64 at +8/+12; independently paired with UserIdToSteam discriminator check.

anchors.name: Player identity UserIdToSteam
anchors.reason: Released converter checks discriminator 1 and copies +8/+12 to CSteamID; other providers convert to zero. No GOG ID is relabeled as Steam.

anchors.name: Terrain placement FindClass
anchors.reason: String-to-project-id then GameObjectClass::Find, used by released native BuildObject helper 0x5c82b0. May load an ODF class but does not create a game object.

anchors.name: Terrain placement ClassBounds
anchors.reason: Returns class bounds +0x10c, lazily loads model bounds if necessary. Used by ConstructionRig placement 0x49d230, which expands X/Z by 10 before CanBuildHere.

anchors.name: Terrain placement CanBuildHere
anchors.reason: Released rig placement 0x49d34d passes expanded bounds and placement matrix; checks blocked cells, terrain height variance and object obstruction. Return al consumed at 0x49d355.

anchors.name: Terrain placement FindFloor
anchors.reason: Released ConstructionRig::SetConstructionMatrix at 0x49cf90 pushes a 24-byte double position into this floor reader and uses its x87 result as placement height.

anchors.name: Terrain placement TeamGet
anchors.reason: Team lookup used by stock IsTeamAllied helper 0x5c9530 before calling Team::IsAllied.

anchors.name: Terrain placement TeamIsAllied
anchors.reason: Stock alliance check used by GameObject::FriendP and IsTeamAllied. Tests the team alliance bitmask and rejects neutral team 0.

anchors.name: Terrain placement PowerPlantListReference
anchors.reason: Released rig placement power check loads powerplant vector 0x025cce7c, walks allied plants and compares transformed build sphere centre with class range at +0x160.

anchors.name: Player identity FindNetPlayer
anchors.reason: Live network-id lookup identity, shared with qualified stock scoreboard reader.
